description: This PHP source file defines the class OpenIDConnectClient, which extends a third-party OpenID Connect client class. It customizes session handling and URL generation for OpenID Connect authentication within the OrangeHRM OpenID authentication plugin.

classes.name: OpenIDConnectClient
classes.description: A subclass extending an external OpenID Connect client to integrate with OrangeHRM's authentication system, adding session management and URL generation features.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Stores the URL to redirect to during authentication.

methods.name: commitSession
methods.description: Placeholder method for committing session data; currently does nothing.

methods.name: setSessionKey
methods.description: Sets a session attribute for the authenticated user.

methods.name: getSessionKey
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute for the authenticated user.

methods.name: unsetSessionKey
methods.description: Removes a session attribute from the authenticated user.
